sentences.show: Mussolini told Greece to let his army in. Greece answered with one word.
On this day in 1940, his invasion ground to a halt.
Before dawn on October 28th, Italy's ambassador woke the Greek leader, Metaxas.
The demand: let Italian troops occupy Greece.
Metaxas replied: "Then it is war." Greeks remember one word. Ochi. No.
Italy attacked from Albania, before its own deadline ran out.
Their general promised to finish the Greeks in two weeks.
Instead, in the mountains, the Greeks held, and an Italian division was almost wiped out.
On November 8th, the offensive was called off, and its commander removed.
Then the Greeks pushed the Italians back into Albania.
The first Axis setback of the war. Greece still celebrates the day it said no.
Also on this day: Australia lost its war against emus, and the Stockholm Bloodbath shocked Sweden.
